annotations.title: List the faces for your screens

description:
List the faces for your screens

Lists the faces a Presence screen can show: your own faces with `id` and review `status`, and the names of the ready made faces. To put one of your own faces on a screen, send its `id` as `avatarProfileId` to `update_presence_device`; `null` there means voice only. `available` is false when faces are switched off; screens then talk by voice only and the ready made list is empty. A new own face is requested in the dashboard or with `POST /presence/avatars`. Read only.
name: list_presence_avatars
